Program Overview

The Leverhulme Trust Early Career Fellowship is a , fully funded fellowship designed to support early-career researchers in conducting independent research for 3 years at a UK institution. While not exclusively for AI/CS, it is highly relevant for researchers in computational fields, including machine learning, data science, and AI ethics.

Funding & Benefits

  • Salary: Full salary (typically £40,000-£50,000 per year, depending on experience)
  • Research Expenses: Up to £6,000 per year for research costs, travel, and equipment
  • Duration: 3 years
  • Location: Any UK university or research institution
  • Additional Benefits: Mentoring, networking events, and career development support

Eligibility Criteria

  • Career Stage: Early-career researchers (typically within 4 years of PhD completion, with limited research experience)
  • Nationality: Open to UK and international applicants
  • Research Area: Any discipline, but AI/CS projects are encouraged
  • Track Record: Demonstrated potential for independent research

Application Process

  1. Identify host institution and sponsor.
  2. Develop research proposal (3-page outline).
  3. Submit application to Leverhulme Trust.
  4. Review and interview process.
  5. Award notification.

Required Documents

  • Research Proposal (3-page outline)
  • CV highlighting academic achievements and research experience
  • Sponsor Letter from a senior researcher at host institution
  • Justification for Resources (budget for research expenses)

Timeline & Deadlines

Official Link

https://www.leverhulme.ac.uk

Important Notes

  • Leverage the Leverhulme Trust's focus on "original research" by proposing an interdisciplinary AI project.
  • UK funding body with strong reputation.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 24 October 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
